task_grounding:
Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/song.aup loaded. The project contains a single stereo wavetrack (~3 seconds). The project currently has no metadata tags.

Do the following in order:

1. Open Edit > Metadata... and set these tag values exactly:
   - Title: Starlight
   - Artist: Nova Sound
   - Year: 2025
   Click OK to accept.

2. Save the project with Ctrl+S (so the tags are persisted inside /home/user/Music/song.aup).

3. Export the audio as a WAV file to /home/user/Music/starlight.wav using File > Export > Export as WAV... In the Save dialog, type 'starlight.wav' and choose /home/user/Music as the directory. Keep the 'Save as type' set to 'WAV (Microsoft) signed 16-bit PCM'. Click Save. If an 'Edit Metadata Tags' dialog appears on top of the export, just click OK to accept the same tags.

Both the updated /home/user/Music/song.aup AND the exported /home/user/Music/starlight.wav must exist. Do not rename the project file and do not export to a different location.
